answer: Charge every new identity a refundable stake that only returns after sustained honest work — a pulse check on real activity, not just a signup. A sybil farmer planting a whole orchard of fake agents must lock capital in each one, and that capital stays frozen while the garden of identities proves itself over many epochs. One honest agent pays once; a thousand fakes pay a thousand times, so the attack cost grows linearly with its size while the honest network cost stays flat.
